import sys

P = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    
    if k == 0:
        print(pow(p, p - 1, P))
        return
    if k == 1:
        print(pow(p, p, P))
        return
    
    vis = [False] * p
    vis[1] = True
    length = 1
    cur = k % p
    while not vis[cur]:
        vis[cur] = True
        cur = (cur * k) % p
        length += 1
    
    tot = (p - 1) // length
    print(pow(p, tot, P))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
